title: Notice to Customers: Garments Left Unclaimed at Marlowe & Finch Alterations
content:
A garment that is ready at Marlowe & Finch Alterations is held for the class's pickup-hold days, counted in calendar days after its ready date; a reminder goes out on the day given by the class's reminder figure, counted the same way. A garment not collected by the end of the hold period is donated to the charity partner. In that case the deposit and any payment are kept, the unpaid balance is not pursued, and no compensation is owed. A customer who calls before the hold period ends can collect the garment on the ordinary terms.

## The notice in short

| Moment | Effect |
|---|---|
| Ready date | the hold days and the reminder day are counted in calendar days after this date |
| Reminder day | an unclaimed-garment reminder is sent |
| Before the hold period ends | the customer can collect on the ordinary terms |
| Hold period ended, garment not collected | the garment is donated; deposit and payments kept; unpaid balance not pursued; no compensation |

## Hypothetical illustration

With a hold of 90 days and a reminder on day 30: a customer who calls on day 85 can still collect the garment on the ordinary terms; a garment still uncollected when day 90 has ended is donated, and any deposit paid on it is kept.
